entries.title: Project Zomboid

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with Workshop/mod support.

primary.version: Current Steam Early Access release, stable branch recommended
primary.why: Project Zomboid is still an Early Access PC game, and Windows PC is the best route for performance, capture, mod support, multiplayer hosting, and Steam Workshop access. Build 42 has newer content in an unstable branch, but the stable Steam branch is the safer full-play recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Project Zomboid on Steam for Windows PC and play the default stable branch for reliable saves, servers, and mods. Opt into Build 42 only if you accept beta instability and mod/save disruption.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game remains in Early Access. Build 42 is an unstable branch rather than a separate edition or sequel.
